name: Jacket launch truss
description: Two heavy longitudinal girders on a jacket's launch face that carry the structure as it slides off a launch barge. They are a significant share of jacket steel and are sometimes removed after installation.

gaps.what: Launch truss weight, launch load case and rocker-beam interface
gaps.why: No page read gives a launch-truss weight fraction or the launch analysis load case.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a launch analysis or installation paper and record truss weight, launch load case and rocker-beam detail

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
